inputs.style: head of growth — sharp, dry, a little irreverent. Speaks at a measured, unhurried pace and lets each line land. Confident and decisive: makes the call and moves. A wry half-smile in the voice, like he's three ideas ahead and mildly amused by it. Casual but never sloppy.
inputs.text: 我是西奥。我写文案不喊口号，看数据决定下周的钱该往哪儿花。
